 South Dakota minimum wage to increase in 2027 
 The South Dakota state minimum wage for non-tipped employees will increase, effective Jan. 1, 2027. By Avery Arens Published : Nov. 17, 2026 at 2:32 PM CST | Updated : 12 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google SIOUX FALLS, S.D. (Dakota News Now) - The South Dakota state minimum wage for non-tipped employees will increase, effective Jan. 1, 2027.
 South Dakota’s minimum wage for non-tipped employees will increase from $11.85 to $12.30 per hour.
 The hourly minimum wage for tipped employees will also rise from $5.925 to $6.15 .
 South Dakota has adjusted its minimum wage annually since 2016 under state law. The increases apply to employers across the state, with limited exceptions.
